task_instance: Draft a complete offer letter (comp table, terms, benefits, full letter text, hiring-manager notes) for a sample candidate 'Jordan Alvarez' being offered Senior Backend Engineer at a fictional company 'Northwind Analytics, Inc.', given role/level/location/comp/start date/manager details as input.
evidence: Created input.md with sample candidate/role/comp details in the work directory. Wrote offer_draft.md following the SKILL.md output template exactly: Compensation Package table (base $165,000, 8,000 RSUs w/ 4yr vest & 1yr cliff, $15,000 signing bonus, 15% target bonus, computed Total First-Year Comp of $204,750), Terms (start date, reports-to, location, employment type), Benefits Summary, full Offer Letter Text addressed to the candidate referencing a specific interview detail (event-driven architecture discussion) for personalization, and Notes for Hiring Manager (comp-band verification flag, headcount approval flag, negotiation guidance, personalization note, equity-valuation flag). Verified via grep that all 5 required section headers from the template are present in offer_draft.md (56 lines total). No network access, credentials, or connector tools (HRIS/ATS) were needed or used; the skill's own document marks those as optional 'If Connectors Available' enhancements, and their absence was simply documented as caveats in the draft rather than blocking the core deliverable (the offer letter itself).
